request.idle: Run the request to inspect the live response from the current snapshot.
request.failed: The request did not complete. Check your connection and retry.

errors.badRequest: The cursor is invalid or does not match the active filters. Run the query again from the first page.
errors.notFound: No resource matched this ID in the current snapshot. Check the ID or list resources to copy a valid oa_ ID.
errors.obsoleteSnapshot: The snapshot changed while paging. Run the query again without a cursor to read from the current snapshot.
errors.noSnapshot: No validated snapshot is currently available to serve requests. Check /v1/status and retry later.
errors.unexpected: The request returned an error. If status is 422, check your query parameters against the documented limits in the response body; otherwise retry.

overview.title: Query public OpenAI Academy learning resources
overview.lede: Read-only JSON endpoints for searching and inspecting indexed public OpenAI Academy courses, learning paths, videos, and articles without an API key.
overview.baseUrlLede: All endpoints are public read-only GET routes under this origin and require no API key or bearer token.
overview.quickStartHeading: Fetch your first page of resources
overview.quickStartLede: Run this curl command in your terminal to retrieve up to five indexed learning resources.
overview.endpointsLede: Select a catalog route to view its parameters and response schema, or open the operational routes directly.
overview.tryLede: Choose an endpoint to query the current local snapshot directly from your browser.

conventions.readOnly: Snapshot-backed reads: Every request reads a validated local snapshot and never triggers a live crawl, source fetch, or model call.
conventions.cursors: Snapshot-scoped pagination: Results are ordered by ascending stable oa_ ID; cursors bind to your active filters and snapshotId, returning 400 on filter mismatch or 409 if the snapshot changed.
conventions.nulls: Explicit empty values: Responses use camelCase and keep all documented fields present, returning null or [] when a fact is unverified or absent on the source page.
conventions.durations: Distinct duration units: duration.courseMinutes, duration.pathMinutes, and duration.videoSeconds measure different scopes and are never summed or converted into one another.
conventions.sources: Canonical source links: Each resource ID (oa_ plus 24 hex characters) hashes its canonical public Academy URL, and url plus provenance.sourceUrls link directly to the original pages.
conventions.notExposed: Catalog metadata only: The API does not provide user enrollment, learner progress, gated course packages, or media redistribution rights (media is [] unless explicit reuse permission is recorded).

overview.linksLede: Inspect the OpenAPI 3.1 schema, check server health, or view the repository.

resources.title: List and filter learning resources
resources.lede: Search the current snapshot by keyword, category, kind, or target audience with deterministic cursor pagination.

params.q: Case-insensitive text search across resource titles, summaries, and tags (up to 200 characters).
params.category: Category slug from GET /v1/categories (lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens, up to 100 characters).
params.kind: Resource format filter: course, learning-path, article, video, event, collection, or external.
params.audience: Target audience filter: general, knowledge-workers, developers, leaders, educators, students, admins, or other.
params.cursor: Opaque pagination token from nextCursor; must be sent with the same filters against the same snapshotId.
params.limit: Maximum number of resources to return per page (1 to {max}, default {default}).

resources.shapeNote: Items are sorted by ascending resource ID so pages stay deterministic within a snapshot.

response.items: Page of matching Resource objects ordered by ascending stable ID.
response.nextCursor: Opaque cursor for the next page of results, or null when no further items match.
response.total: Total number of resources in the snapshot matching the active filters.
response.snapshotId: SHA-256 identifier of the snapshot serving this page.

resources.tryLede: Set optional filters and run a request. Changing any filter resets pagination to the first page.

filters.categoryUnavailable: Category list could not be loaded from /v1/categories. You can still run other filters.

resources.empty: No resources in the current snapshot matched these filters. Clear or broaden a filter and run the request again.

resource.title: Fetch a single resource by ID
resource.lede: Fetch full metadata, structured curriculum sections, distinct durations, and provenance for a single resource ID.
resource.shapeNote: Every documented field is present in the JSON payload; unknown or unverified values are null or empty arrays.

fields.id: Stable identifier: oa_ followed by the first 24 lowercase hex characters of the canonical URL's SHA-256 hash.
fields.title: Official resource title from the public source page.
fields.url: Canonical public destination URL on academy.openai.com.
fields.kind: Resource format: course, learning-path, article, video, event, collection, or external.
fields.categoryIds: Category slugs from /v1/categories that include this resource.
fields.audiences: Normalized audience tags such as developers, knowledge-workers, leaders, or general.
fields.tags: Topic and skill tags recorded from the source page.
fields.summary: Short description of the resource, or null when not stated on the source.
fields.level: Difficulty level (beginner, intermediate, or advanced), or null when unspecified.
fields.duration: Object with separate courseMinutes, pathMinutes, and videoSeconds fields; values are never combined.
fields.detail: Structured learning notes containing free-text audience, prerequisites, objectives, and ordered curriculum sections.
fields.media: Permitted external media references with evidence URLs; empty unless reuse permission is documented.
fields.artwork: Public cover image metadata: url (HTTPS image URL on d2xo500swnpgl1.cloudfront.net), alt (text or null), and sourceUrl (an Academy page listed in provenance.sourceUrls). Null when no cover is recorded; unlike media, it carries no reuse permission.
fields.provenance: Source URLs, UTC fetch timestamp, normalized metadata SHA-256 hash, and collection method (managed-agent, manual, or fixture).

resource.idHint: Enter an oa_ resource ID, or select a resource from the Resources page to populate this request.

categories.title: List indexed resource categories
categories.lede: Retrieve the category slugs, display labels, and resource counts present in the current snapshot.
categories.shapeNote: Pass any category id as the category query parameter on GET /v1/resources to filter resources in that category.

response.items: List of categories present in the active snapshot.
response.id: Lowercase slug used as the category query parameter on /v1/resources.
response.label: Human-readable category name from the public Academy directory.
response.count: Number of indexed resources assigned to this category in the current snapshot.
response.snapshotId: SHA-256 identifier of the snapshot serving these counts.

categories.empty: No categories are recorded in the current snapshot.

status.title: Snapshot freshness and coverage status
status.lede: Check whether the active snapshot is fresh, stale, or unavailable, along with refresh timestamps and per-category collection coverage.

fields.freshness: Snapshot state: fresh, stale, or unavailable. Reports stale when the snapshot is older than 7 days, coverage is incomplete, the latest refresh failed, or the server fell back to a prior snapshot after a read error.
fields.resourceCount: Total number of validated resources in the active snapshot (does not imply all public OpenAI Academy content is indexed).
fields.coverage: Per-category records reporting categoryId, state (complete, partial, or not-collected), discovered count, and collected count.

status.note: The response also reports snapshotId (active SHA-256 hash or null) and UTC timestamps for generatedAt, lastAttemptAt, and lastSuccessAt; failed refreshes keep serving the last validated snapshot.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lede: No documentation page matches this URL path.
